action.prompt: Review src/scene/** against the performance budget in .kiro/steering/tech.md. Look for: non-instanced repeated meshes, more than 4 shadow-casting lights, per-frame object allocations inside useFrame, React state updates inside useFrame, uncompressed or oversized assets, missing dispose on unmount, and post-processing passes that could be merged. Report the top 5 issues by likely fps impact with file:line, then fix the ones I approve.
